attributes.name: dark surface color
attributes.definition: The hue used for dark page regions such as top bar, bands, CTA sections and footer.

values.definition: Dark surfaces are deep navy blue.
Dark surfaces use another dark hue (black, charcoal, brown, etc.).
Page has no dark bands or surfaces.

attributes.name: text color on dark surfaces
attributes.definition: The color of text placed on dark bands or footer.

values.definition: Soft, warm beige or cream text on dark areas.
Pure or near-white text on dark areas.
Another text color on dark areas.
